t: Accepting terms that looked like a defeat
a: اكْتُبِ الشَّرْطَ بَيْنَنَا بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ هَذَا مَا قَاضَى عَلَيْهِ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
m: They objected to Messenger of Allah, so he told ʿAlī to erase it. ʿAlī said he could not. So the Prophet ﷺ erased it himself and wrote: this is what Muhammad son of ʿAbdullāh has agreed.
